result.stdout:
camw - constraint-aware mixed watermarking (authenticated payload)

USAGE
  camw seal    --secret <s> [--token <hex>] [--version N] [--purpose N] [--context <c>] [--in <file>] [--out <file>] [options]
  camw recover --secret <s> [--context <c>] [--in <file> ...] [--json] [options]

COMMANDS
  seal      Embed an authenticated, error-corrected release token into the input.
  recover   Decode and cryptographically verify the token (HKDF + HMAC + Reed-Solomon).

PAYLOAD
  --secret <s>    Master secret; the whole key hierarchy is derived from it.
  --token <hex>   24-hex-char (12-byte) release token; random if omitted (seal).
  --version <n>   Dataset version, 0-65535 (seal).
  --purpose <n>   Purpose code, 0-65535 (seal).
  --context <c>   Context string (e.g. schema id) authenticated into the tag (both).

INPUT / OUTPUT
  --in <file>     Read input from a file (repeatable for recover); default stdin, or '-'.
  --out <file>    Write output to a file (seal only); default stdout.
  --json          Emit a machine-readable recovery report.

CHANNELS (must match between seal and recover)
  --culture <c>       Culture for number formatting, e.g. de-DE. Default invariant.
  --no-homoglyphs     Disable the homoglyph channel.
  --no-zero-width     Disable the zero-width channel.
  --no-numeric        Disable the numeric channel.
  --synonyms <lang>   Enable the synonym channel for a language (en, de).
  --include-integers  Watermark integers too (changes value by 1; off by default).

EXAMPLES
  camw seal --secret owner-key --version 7 --in report.txt --out report.sealed.txt
  camw recover --secret owner-key --in report.sealed.txt

EXIT CODES
  0 authenticated watermark recovered    1 usage or IO error    2 no watermark
